title: POR QUE O MERCADO ESTÁ CAINDO? A VERDADE QUE NINGUÉM TE CONTOU
subTitle:
Se tu estás a ver o teu portfólio a cair e não estás a entender porquê, não és o único.
O preço está a cair, mas os fundamentos de cripto não pioraram. Pelo contrário, cada vez mais bancos estão a anunciar que vão usar cripto e blockchain.
Então por que está tudo vermelho?
A resposta não está dentro de cripto. Está fora.
1. A QUEDA DAS AÇÕES DE IA PUXOU TUDO PARA BAIXO
Nas últimas semanas, as ações de empresas de IA e de semicondutores caíram em massa, principalmente a Nvidia.
Quando uma ação grande cai assim, acontece uma coisa perigosa: chamada de margem.
É simples: quem comprou com dinheiro emprestado é obrigado a vender à pressa para cobrir a dívida. E quando essa pessoa também tem cripto, ela vende cripto também para conseguir dinheiro rápido.
Foi esse efeito dominó que começou a pressão de venda. Principalmente na Ásia, onde muitos investidores de varejo estavam muito alavancados.
2. TODO MUNDO VENDENDO PARA ENTRAR NO IPO DA ANTHROPIC
A Anthropic, a empresa por trás da Claude, está a preparar o seu IPO, a entrada na bolsa.
E para comprar uma ação nova dessas, o investidor precisa de dinheiro em caixa.
O que ele faz? Vende o que tem. Vende ação, vende cripto, vende tudo para juntar dinheiro para o IPO.
É um choque de oferta: muita gente a vender ao mesmo tempo para entrar numa única oportunidade.
3. O HACK DE 6,3 BILHÕES QUE VOLTOU AO MERCADO
Outro motivo que quase ninguém falou: fundos ligados a um hack de 6,3 bilhões de dólares foram recentemente devolvidos aos donos das contas.
E o que essa pessoa faz quando recebe milhões de volta depois de meses? Ela não segura. Ela converte tudo para dinheiro ou para stablecoin na hora, com medo de perder de novo.
Isso jogou mais venda no mercado, sem ninguém comprar do outro lado.
4. O MEDO DA IA "QUEBRAR TUDO"
Durante a apresentação da Anthropic para investidores, falaram muito sobre como a IA vai transformar e até "quebrar" setores inteiros, defesa cibernética e empresas.
Isso criou um medo existencial: se a IA vai quebrar tudo, o que é seguro?
Junta isso com a investigação dos EUA sobre venda de chips para a Ásia e China, e tens o cenário perfeito para o pânico. Cripto caiu por medo de mais notícias ruins da Ásia, não por problema de cripto em si.
ENTÃO, É O FIM?
Não. E é aqui que eu discordo da maioria.
Cripto continua a ser o futuro das finanças. O blockchain vai ser a camada onde as transações vão ser liquidadas. Os ativos digitais vão transformar o mercado de capitais.
O que estamos a ver é uma tempestade temporária, não o fim do ciclo. Tom Lee chama isso de "superciclo" - um ciclo maior que os anteriores.
Os ventos contrários vão passar. O ETH, na minha visão, continua a ser uma das peças mais importantes desse futuro.
O QUE EU ESTOU A FAZER?
Eu estou de fora, sem alavancagem, sem pressa. Não estou a tentar adivinhar o fundo.
Quando o mercado cai por motivos de fora, ele costuma recuperar quando esses motivos passam. Vender no pânico é entregar o teu dinheiro a quem está a comprar barato.
Agora me diz: tu achas que essa queda é só por causa da IA e do IPO, ou tem algo mais escondido?

BitMine Marks 6.07 Million ETH at $2,234. The Market Is Paying $1,822

BitMine Immersion Technologies valued its 6,070,092 ether at $2,234 per token in the 8-K it filed on November 9. At the $1,821.97 ether traded for at 03:52 UTC on November 16, the same stack is worth $11.06 billion, roughly $2.50 billion below the company’s own carrying price.

The gap is arithmetic, not an accusation. BitMine marks its treasury at Coinbase’s ether price on the measurement date, so the $2,234 entry was accurate for 2:00 p.m. ET on November 8. What changed is the market. Ether closed at $1,768.45 on November 15, its lowest daily close since July 10, and has since recovered about 3% to $1,822. Every dollar the token loses now comes off a treasury that the company describes as 4.97% of the total ether supply of 122.2 million tokens

The Eight Days Between the Mark and the Market
The disclosure is unusually granular for a corporate treasury, which makes the repricing easy to trace line by line. As of November 8, BitMine reported 6,070,092 $ETH at $2,234 each, 216 bitcoin, a $180 million stake in Beast Industries, $75 million of Eightco Holdings (NASDAQ: ORBS), and $475 million in cash and marketable securities. The company put the total at $14.3 billion
Rebuilding that ledger at the November 16 ether price, with bitcoin at 64,944, gives 11.06 billion of ether, 14.03 million of bitcoin, and the same 730 million of moonshots and cash. The total lands at 11.80 billion, 17.5% below the number printed eight days earlier. Ether supplies almost all of that difference; the remaining assets are too small, and too stable, to shift the total by more than a few tens of millions.

It shows a September 22 peak of $2,775.17, a slide through October, and the November 15 close that broke the August shelf near 1,912. How it works: ETH/BTC measures relative strength, not whether prices are rising or falling. If both coins fall 10%, the exchange rate stays unchanged; if ETH falls 15% and BTC falls 10%, the rate drops. During a steep sell-off, money tends to move back into BTC as a safe haven, and ETH is sold more heavily, pushing the rate down. The rate only rises consistently when new buyers are willing to pay a higher premium for ETH.

What most people get wrong: They use ETH's dollar-price moves to judge whether it's strong. ETH's dollar price = the ETH/BTC exchange rate × BTC's dollar price. translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is a payment between longs and shorts
that they pay to each other. The exchange simply collects and distributes the payments; it doesn’t profit from them.

【Mechanism】Perpetual contracts have no settlement date. So how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? That’s what the funding rate is for:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (strong bullish sentiment) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between both sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

I’d rather look at data that can be independently checked. At the time of this review, CoinGlass’s ETH page showed about $57.73 million in futures liquidations tracked over the past 24 hours, with longs accounting for 48%—meaning shorts made up nearly half as well. Its weighted funding rate was around -0.0036%, and open interest was about $22.01 billion in notional value. These are all aggregated snapshots over rolling windows; coverage and calculation methods vary by platform, so they can’t identify any particular “whale,” let alone prove that everyone is positioned in the same direction. A negative funding rate means that, at the time, shorts were paying funding; it doesn’t guarantee that the next candle will rise. When both longs and shorts are being liquidated, the easiest mistake is to confuse increased volatility with confirmation of a trend.

Spot market and institutional data should also be considered separately. Binance’s public market data showed ETH/USDT at around $1,812.42 when I wrote this, up about 0.98% over the past 24 hours, with a range of $1,773.13 to $1,845.18—showing that the market was not in a sustained one-way decline. The Farside table showed total net inflows of about $2.3 million into U.S. spot ETH funds on November 13, but that reflects fund share changes from the previous trading day, and the amount is too small to explain today’s Asian-session price action on its own. According to the official calendar, the Federal Reserve’s October meeting minutes are due to be released on November 18, and interest-rate expectations remain a factor in future risk appetite. If reliable exchange data confirms that the liquidation structure has changed, I’ll update my view rather than cling to this snapshot.

I’m watching $1,773 as the 24-hour low and $1,845 as the high. A break below $1,773 followed by a weak rebound would invalidate the short-term stabilization thesis. Only a move back above $1,845 followed by a successful retest would suggest that buyers may be breaking out of the range. If new significant developments emerge in macroeconomic data or exchange security announcements, price levels will also need to be reassessed; the old plan shouldn’t be followed mechanically.

If I were trading this myself, I’d stay out for now, with a neutral directional bias and a position size of 0. I’d only consider a small spot long, using no more than 1.5% of my total capital, if ETH holds above $1,845, retests without breaking below it, and BTC remains stable at the same time. The entry trigger would be a confirmed retest, with an initial target of $1,875, where I’d sell half, followed by $1,910, where I’d exit gradually. I’d place the stop below the retest low, with no more than 0.3% of account equity at risk on the trade. If, after entry, price falls back below $1,810 and fails to rebound, I’d close the entire position. If price breaks below $1,773 first, I’d cancel the long plan and remain in cash. Conditions that haven’t been triggered don’t count as trades, let alone profits.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds required to open a position. For example, at 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add more margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin threshold: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

quoteContent.bodyTextOnly:

作者：Lockridge Okoth，BeInCrypto

11 月 15 日，比特币在币安平台跌至 62006 美元，创下近三个月低点。这一全球规模最大的加密货币，11 天内累计下跌约 15%。同期，美国投资者从美股上市的比特币基金中撤出资金 19.1 亿美元。（本文统一换算成北京时间）

图：比特币（BTC）价格表现，来源 TradingView

币安联合创始人赵长鹏（CZ）于 11 月 16 日凌晨列出六项潜在诱因，并在开篇便作出提醒：“加密货币为何下跌？没人能给出定论。现象相关，不等于存在因果。”

比特币跌幅情况

9 月末，比特币交易价格接近 87000 美元；时至 11 月 4 日，价格仍维持在 81000 美元上下。11 月 13 日，币价跌破 70000 美元，11 月 15 日下探至 62006 美元，随后反弹至约 64500 美元。

加杠杆看涨的交易者损失最为惨重。加密市场 24 小时内共有约 19.6 亿美元杠杆多头仓位被强制平仓，其中比特币多头仓位占约 6 亿美元。

下文为 CZ 提出的六项可能原因，以及现有公开资料能够印证的信息。

资金是否从加密市场流出，参与 Anthropic IPO 申购？

CZ 的第一个猜想：投资者正在抛售加密货币，转而参与 Anthropic 新股申购。为支撑该观点，他引用了比特币国库管理公司 Strive 董事长兼 CEO Matt Cole 的推文。

Matt Cole 对比了 SpaceX 与 Anthropic 两次巨型 IPO 前夕的比特币行情，提出比特币在 IPO 前下跌，或有资金抽离参与新股认购的猜想。BitMine 董事长 Tom Lee 也提出过相近看法。

本次 IPO 体量巨大。根据 Anthropic 在 11 月 10 日向美国 SEC 提交的修订文件，这款 Claude 对话模型背后的 AI 企业计划发行 8.25 亿股，发行定价区间为 70 至 75 美元。（注：11 月 18 日美股收盘后定价，对应北京时间 11 月 19 日凌晨 5 点之后出定价结果。）

目前没有公开数据可以证实，有多少比特币被卖出用于本次 IPO 申购，甚至无法证实这类卖盘真实存在。

美国投资者正在赎回比特币基金？

属实，这也是六项猜想里，唯一具备可量化数据支撑的一条。

现货比特币 ETF 持有真实比特币，在美国股市像普通个股一样交易，不少美国储蓄投资者和机构都通过这类 ETF 配置比特币。

SoSoValue 数据显示：11 月 5 日至 13 日连续七个交易日，相关 ETF 合计资金流出 19.1 亿美元。仅周五单日，就有 1.854 亿美元资金流出，其中贝莱德 IBIT 流出 1.48 亿美元。

图：比特币现货 ETF 资金流向，数据来源 SoSoValue

币安研究部评价，这是现货 ETF 上线以来，资金流出情况最严重的连续七日行情之一。

黑客攻击与漏洞事件是否引发投资者恐慌？

CZ 提到近期集中爆发的一系列安全事件：币安被盗、iPhone 端加密钱包遭洗劫、Chrome 高危漏洞、微软服务大面积故障。

币安：10 月 30 日凌晨，黑客从交易所盗走约 63 亿美元，为加密行业史上最大失窃案，本次攻击被指向朝鲜黑客。币安表示用户资金均安全，已补足约 98% 被盗资产。

iPhone：安全机构 CertiK 警告，iOS 早期版本存在零日漏洞，允许攻击者获取设备完全控制权，已有大批 iPhone 用户报告加密钱包遭窃。

CZ 写道：“接连发生的安全事件，可能让部分投资者不愿继续持有加密资产。”

通胀数据超预期，是否让美联储重启加息考量？

美国 10 月 CPI 环比上涨 0.4%，高于市场预期的 0.3%；剔除食品与能源的核心 CPI 上涨 0.3%。

美联储理事 Christopher Waller 表态，他倾向于在 12 月实施加息；达拉斯联储主席 Lorie Logan 也表态支持进一步收紧政策。宏观利率预期收紧直接导致风险资产全线受挫。

美债收益率上行、美元走强，是否拖累比特币？

CZ 提出：“收益率走高、美元走强，会对加密货币这类风险资产构成压力。”当美债无风险收益提升，本身不产生利息的比特币，吸引力便会下降。

Finwire 援引 Coinbase 机构研究数据：截至 11 月 13 日，期货市场定价美联储未来一年合计加息 64 个基点，而本月初市场预期仅为 37 个基点。

美国中期选举结果，是否会催生更严格的加密监管？

民主党在 11 月 3 日的中期选举中拿下参众两院控制权。行业寄予厚望、旨在为加密市场建立清晰监管框架的《CLARITY 法案》，早在 9 月参议院关键投票中，以 49 票赞成、50 票反对的结果未能通过。

比特币对选举结果的反应分化：开票阶段价格一度跌至 75600 美元附近，次日又回升至 81000 美元左右。

币安管理层的看法

CZ 表示，币安在本轮下跌期间并未抛售加密资产。“这几天我反而买入了加密货币，因为我刚收到一笔稳定币。（说不定这就是下跌的原因）”他半开玩笑说道。

币安联席 CEO Richard Teng 与何一于周日先后在 X 平台发布内容完全一致的推文，两条发布时间相隔 70 分钟。

“市场短期承压，是宏观环境收紧、AI 融资情绪转向带来的正常反应。但比特币与加密行业的长期逻辑并未改变。”

币安研究部将本次下跌和市场对 AI 企业融资的担忧绑定。在比特币下跌 15.6% 的这 11 个交易日内，美股 AI 云厂商 Nebius 的期货同步大跌 27.5%。

币安研究部这条推文指出，宏观环境收紧、AI 融资信心走弱引发比特币资金大幅外流，11 天内比特币下跌 15.6%，同期 AI 情绪标的 NBIS 永续合约同步大跌，叠加现货比特币 ETF 连续七日大额净流出。

文章同时指出，这种走势上的相关性对比，不能证明 AI 板块资金出逃直接引发比特币下跌。

部分交易员给出更简洁的解读。分析师 Michaël van de Poppe 认为，这是一次少见的杠杆集中出清带动的回调，也就是大量多头杠杆集中平仓引发踩踏；他同时提到自己正在逢低布局。

后续重点关注事件

本周有三个关键节点值得跟踪：

11 月 16 日：周五资金流出之后，最新一期 ETF 资金流向数据公布。

11 月 17 日：英伟达发布财报。这是 Jensen Huang 在 11 月 12 日卸任 CEO、CFO Colette Kress 接任以来的首份财报，市场神经高度紧绷。

11 月 18 日：Anthropic 股票定价。若最终定价落在 70 至 75 美元区间上沿，甚至进一步上调，或意味着更多场内流动性将被分流。

CZ 最后给出长期判断：“中长期来看，加密行业会持续发展。以上仅代表个人观点，不构成投资建议。”

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

Vitalik: EIP-8037 is a practical choice for scaling Ethereum securely; developers should not assume the Gas mechanism will remain unchanged

Vitalik Buterin explained the rationale behind Ethereum proposal EIP-8037 and its implications for application developers.

He said that expanding Ethereum’s execution capacity is relatively easy, but scaling the growth of its state is more difficult. Simply raising the Gas limit could cause the state to expand significantly, increasing the burden on nodes for storage, synchronization, and execution.

EIP-8037 raises the Gas costs of operations such as creating new accounts, storage slots, and contracts, aligning resource pricing with the actual burden on the network. It is currently a more practical approach that balances scaling with decentralized security.

Vitalik noted that the proposal could still affect some existing applications, especially contracts that rely on hard-coded Gas limits or specific call parameters.

Rather than making further protocol-layer changes that could introduce new risks, the priority now is to work with application developers to identify and fix compatibility issues before the Glamsterdam upgrade goes live.

He also advised developers not to treat the Gas mechanism as a fixed, unchanging rule, and called on core developers to clearly document protocol features that may change in the future to reduce unexpected impacts from subsequent upgrades.

都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。
